description: Build a generic mcpServers JSON object for one local stdio command or one remote URL. Client-specific files (Claude Code type, VS Code servers, Codex TOML) are documented on /tools/mcp. This tool does not contact the server.

command.description: Stdio executable when url is omitted. Example: "npx".

env.description: Environment variables for a stdio server. Example: {"GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN":"set-this-locally"}. Do not send a real token to this tool.

url.description: Remote MCP endpoint. When set, command and args are ignored. Example: "https://agenttoolbox.net/api/mcp".

name: mcp_config
title: Generate an MCP client config
